project.name: Skyesoft Prediction Market Lab
project.objective: Determine whether a repeatable and economically useful positive-EV edge exists in Kalshi 15-minute Bitcoin price prediction markets before enabling live trading.
project.longTermObjective: Develop a disciplined and reusable prediction-market research methodology that may expand to additional market families and venues only when warranted by demonstrated positive EV.

governance.principle: Begin with the end in mind.

verifiedCapabilities: Load Kalshi credentials from Skyesoft environment
Read private RSA key outside public web root
Make authenticated HTTPS requests from GoDaddy

phases.name: Read-Only Kalshi API Layer
phases.objective: Convert the successful authentication test into reusable read-only Skyesoft Kalshi API components and inspect the actual BTC 15-minute market payload before designing the persistence schema.
tasks: Retrieve market open and close times
Preserve raw API responses for development
Inspect actual Kalshi BTC 15-minute payload structure
Identify verified fields required for research data contracts
Define canonical research data contracts from verified API fields
Design persistence schema from verified data contracts
constraints: No final database schema based on assumed API fields

phases.name: Opening Market Snapshot
phases.objective: Capture the market state at the beginning of each 15-minute BTC prediction cycle using verified Kalshi fields and approved external market inputs.
phases.note: Final schema and canonical field names will be based on actual Kalshi API payloads rather than assumed field names.

phases.name: Intraperiod Observation Capture
phases.objective: Record how BTC and the prediction market evolve during each 15-minute cycle while preserving point-in-time integrity and source timestamps.
phases.externalDataPolicy: External BTC market data may be used as a predictive research input only when its source timestamp is no later than the relevant observation or decision timestamp. External prices may not substitute for official Kalshi settlement data.
purpose: Analyze whether entry at market open is optimal
Build a trustworthy synchronized research dataset

phases.name: Paper Decision Engine
phases.objective: Generate and permanently record the action that would have been taken using only information available at decision time.

baselineStrategy.purpose: Validate market discovery, lifecycle handling, timestamps, observation capture, raw-data integrity, settlement capture, and research lineage before introducing predictive trading logic.

rules: A recorded decision must not be altered based on subsequent market movement or settlement.
A strategy may use only information available at or before decisionTimestamp.
Each market window counts as one market sample regardless of the number of observations collected.
PASS is a valid and expected decision.

phases.name: Paper Settlement and Performance
phases.objective: Settle each simulated position against the official Kalshi result and calculate performance under a predefined paper-execution standard.
phases.settlementAuthority: Official Kalshi market outcome and applicable settlement data.
rules: External BTC spot prices may not grade settlement.
Paper fills may not be retroactively improved.
Midpoint and last trade price are diagnostic only unless explicitly authorized by a future frozen execution standard.

phases.name: Strategy Evaluation
phases.objective: Determine whether a frozen strategy demonstrates a repeatable edge sufficient to justify further development.
phases.interpretation: The 500-market target is a minimum initial evaluation cohort and is not by itself proof of statistical significance.
phases.primaryQuestion: Does the frozen strategy demonstrate repeatable positive EV after realistic transaction costs and execution assumptions?

phases.name: Strategy Refinement
phases.objective: Use accumulated observations to test whether alternative signals, probability models, trade thresholds, or entry timing improve out-of-sample results.
requirements: Each material strategy change receives a new strategyVersion.
Historical decisions remain attributed to the strategy version that produced them.
Retrospective analysis may inform a future strategy but may not replace prospectively recorded historical decisions.
A new strategy version must be frozen before its evaluation cohort begins.

phases.name: Live Trading Decision
phases.objective: Consider controlled live execution only after paper results demonstrate a durable net-positive edge.
requirements: Positive results under realistic execution assumptions
Explicit human approval to enable live order capability

phases.name: Expansion Decision
phases.objective: Consider applying the validated prediction-market research methodology to additional market families or venues only when evidence from the initial domain warrants expansion.
phases.principle: Failure to demonstrate positive EV in the initial domain does not justify expansion merely in search of easier profits.

proposedStorage.architectureDirection: Design storage around reusable prediction-market research objects while implementing Kalshi BTC 15-minute markets first.

currentCandidateTables.name: tblKalshiMarkets
currentCandidateTables.purpose: One record per BTC 15-minute market window.

currentCandidateTables.name: tblKalshiObservations
currentCandidateTables.purpose: Time-series observations captured during each market window.

currentCandidateTables.name: tblKalshiPaperTrades
currentCandidateTables.purpose: Immutable simulated decisions, execution assumptions, and settlement results.

proposedStorage.note: Current table names are provisional. Final schema will be designed after inspection of actual Kalshi BTC 15-minute API payloads and definition of canonical research data contracts.

currentStrategy.purpose: Establish trustworthy data collection, lifecycle handling, settlement capture, and research integrity before introducing predictive decisions.

firstPredictiveStrategy.purpose: Establish the first frozen prospective baseline strategy after sufficient real BTC 15-minute market observations have been collected and researched.
firstPredictiveStrategy.decisionModel: Estimate event probability using temporally eligible information, compare that estimate with realistically executable Kalshi market economics, and trade only when estimated net EV exceeds the frozen strategy threshold.
firstPredictiveStrategy.note: Candidate signals are research hypotheses only and are not yet an implemented strategy.

longTermStrategy.doctrine: Specialize first, demonstrate edge, repeat conservatively, and expand only when warranted by evidence.
longTermStrategy.profitModel: The project does not depend on large individual bets. Its working hypothesis is that small, statistically defensible positive-EV opportunities may produce meaningful cumulative results through disciplined repetition.
longTermStrategy.scalingPrinciple: Repetition may scale a demonstrated edge. Increasing individual bet size is not the primary scaling mechanism.
longTermStrategy.capitalPrinciple: Position size remains subordinate to uncertainty, bankroll preservation, drawdown limits, and risk controls.
longTermStrategy.noTradeRequirement: The system is never required to trade. PASS is preferable to taking a position without sufficient expected value.
longTermStrategy.futureArchitecture: The long-term platform should support additional venues and market families without weakening the specialized research requirements of each domain.

nextAction.task: Query the Kalshi API from GoDaddy to discover the active BTC 15-minute market and inspect the actual market payload before designing the database schema.
